<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial rulings on state entities:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that the National Book Trust qualifies as a government entity under Article 12, while also clarifying legal standards regarding the retirement of government employees without a hearing.</li>
  <li><strong>Environmental and infrastructure mandates:</strong> Following judicial scrutiny, the Centre has significantly increased library space allocations, and the Supreme Court has ordered a time-bound action plan to address vehicular pollution in the Delhi-NCR region.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
